description:
Remove the hierarchy wrappers, so each caller propagates the one constructor's error.

## Background

`repository_state::hierarchy_config` is called at `commands/validate.rs:1445,1955,2291`, `commands/gate_check.rs:495,576`, `commands/template.rs:498`, `commands/mod.rs:1153`, `commands/archive.rs:515` and `validation/repository.rs:590`. `config_manager::get_hierarchy_config` is called at `commands/graph.rs:230,310,398,490,578`, `commands/document.rs:155,214`, `commands/archive.rs:159,180`, `commands/validate.rs:1473` and `crates/server/src/routes.rs:178`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The silent empty-hierarchy fallback in `repository_state/default_rules.rs` is gone, together with `repository_state::hierarchy_config`, and `get_hierarchy_config` returns the constructor's error unwrapped.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each listed caller propagates that error, and the server maps it to an error response.
- [hard] REQ-03: An invalid hierarchy produces the same `ConfigError` through each command family.
title: Hierarchy callers propagate the constructor's error
